title: Objective 3 - verify button is hidden in portrait orientation
symptom: When trying to complete objective 3 question, the verify button is hidden in portrait orientation. In landscape it is present. Presumably translation is too long and button doesn't fit the screen anymore.
cause: The issue is related to the user's accessibility setting (likely font size) combined with translations.
fix: Reset accessibility setting to default or set a smaller font in Accessibility settings. Also, translations can be changed in Crowdin.
evidence_quote: Setting smaller font in Accessibility settings made it visible, thanks.
